description: This file implements serialization utilities including character encoding conversions, hexadecimal and base64 encoding/decoding, and UTF-16 code point handling, as well as string quoting helpers.

methods.name: string ToString(const char realString[],unsigned int length)

methods.description: Returns a string with quotes around it, escaping internal quote characters.
